query:
SELECT library_id AS "library!", plugin AS "plugin!",
                              backdrop AS "backdrop!", ids AS "ids?: String",
                              title_sources AS "title_sources!"
                       FROM (SELECT library_files.library_id, item_matches.plugin,
                                    item_matches.backdrop, libraries.title_sources, (SELECT json_group_object(namespace, value) FROM item_match_ids
              WHERE item_match_ids.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND scope = IIF(library_items.kind = 'movie', 'title', 'show')) AS ids,
                                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY library_files.library_id
                                                       ORDER BY library_items.id DESC) AS newest
                             FROM item_matches
                             JOIN library_items ON library_items.id = item_matches.item_id
                             JOIN library_files ON library_files.id = library_items.file_id
                             JOIN libraries ON libraries.id = library_files.library_id
                             WHERE item_matches.state = 'matched'
                               AND item_matches.backdrop IS NOT NULL)
                       WHERE newest = 1
